trial_court: SH. N. K. MALHOTRA, DISTRICT JUDGE, (COMMERCIAL COURT)-06, CNR No. DLWT010045542025, CS(COMM) 393/2025
case_name: State Bank Of India vs Ashok

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: State Bank Of India, Constituted under State Bank of Act,1955

facts_of_case: The plaintiff bank granted a personal loan of Rs.12,07,100/- to the defendant under MC-TL-Xpress Credit Apr21 scheme. The present suit is for recovery of Rs. 10,34,379/-.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the plaintiff to prove that the defendant is liable for the loan.
legal_principles.held: The defendant has not received any notice from the plaintiff's bank prior to declaration of NPA to the defendant's loan account.

legal_principles.principle: A loan agreement must be executed between the parties to make the defendant liable for the loan.
legal_principles.held: The plaintiff bank has not filed any Authorization letter/board resolution in favour of Siddhant Agarwal, Branch Manager to file the present suit.

outcome.final_order: The court decided in favor of the plaintiff and ordered the defendant to pay the amount of Rs. 10,34,379/-.

use_for_drafting: drafting a suit for recovery of debt
understanding the role of nationalized banks in land acquisition
applying principles of Specific Relief Act
